page.title: Your profile
page.lede: Everything we know about you, and where each fact came from. Tap a source to see the quote, confirm it, or fix it.
page.complete: Complete enough for every kind of application we prepare.
page.recordLede: Green means you confirmed it. Grey shows the file it came from. Amber means we're unsure or have no source — we never use those without asking.

record.emptyBody: Add a résumé, a deck or a few links on the right and your record fills in here, every line with its source.
record.name: Name
record.headline: Headline
record.skillsHint: Tap a skill to see where it came from.
record.noSourceToast: No source for this one yet. Upload the document it comes from, or fix it from the card above.
record.unsureNote: Amber facts need a quick look before we use them in an application. Tap one to confirm or fix it.

pack.teamValue: {count, plural, one {# person} other {at least # people}}

sources.confirmedLong: You confirmed this. It stays as you said, whatever a document says later.
sources.noQuote: We inferred this from your sources; there is no single line to quote.
sources.confirmHint: Confirm it and we'll use it as you see it.
sources.dateHint: Year, or year and month: 2024 or 2024-06

versions.title: Versions
versions.lede: A new version starts each time your sources are read, you confirm your profile, or you restore one. Applications cite the version they used.
versions.summary: {roles, plural, one {# role} other {# roles}} · {schools, plural, one {# school} other {# schools}} · {skills, plural, one {# skill} other {# skills}}
versions.none: Your first version appears once your sources are read.
versions.confirmBody: It comes back as a new version; nothing is deleted. If you add or remove a source later, we rebuild from your sources again and keep everything you confirmed.

documents.title: Your documents
documents.lede: What you gave us, what we read from each, and the documents we drafted for your applications.
documents.generatedLede: Cover letters, résumé versions, emails and answers, written only from your sourced facts.
documents.emptyBody: Drop a résumé, a deck or a portfolio below, or paste a few links.
documents.generatedEmptyBody: When you tap Apply on an opportunity, the documents it needs are drafted here from your profile.
documents.readNothing: Read. Nothing to add from this one.
documents.removeBody: “{name}” and everything read only from it leave your profile. What you confirmed yourself stays.
documents.removed: Removed. Your profile is being rebuilt without it.
documents.skippedLinkedin: Saved as a link. To import it, open your LinkedIn profile, choose More → Save to PDF, and drop the PDF here.
documents.skippedScholar: Saved as a link. Google Scholar can't be read automatically — upload your CV or add your ORCID iD instead.

goals.title: What you're going for
goals.lede: Each goal has a success definition, milestones from its playbook, and a pace. Change any of it with a tap.
goals.addLede: Pick the goal, what success looks like, by when and how hard to push.
goals.addedToast: Goal added. New picks are on their way.
goals.emptyBody: Set what you're going for and we plan your weeks around it.
goals.dropBody: We stop looking for it. Applications already under way stay on your board.

home.title: Your week
home.lede: Your path, your next steps and your best picks.
home.ledeNew: A few questions about you, then we plan your path and find your first picks.
home.sectionError: This part didn't load. Refresh to try again.

start.title: Start with what you already have
start.body: A résumé, a deck, a portfolio or a few links. We build your profile from them, find openings you can win, and prepare each application for your tap.

needsYou.title: Needs you
needsYou.empty: Nothing needs you right now. We'll tell you when something does.

picks.title: Best picks for you
picks.emptyBody: We're matching you now; new picks appear here and on Scout.
picks.emptyNoGoal: Set a goal and we'll match opportunities to it.
picks.findingBody: We're matching you against what's open now. This takes a few seconds.

practice.title: Try a practice application
practice.body: See the whole flow end to end — prepared answers, a document, your confirmation, a submission and its receipt — on our own sandbox form. Nothing leaves Onward Scout.

events.draft_claimed: Saved your scout to your account
events.application_followup_ready: A follow-up is ready for your tap
events.application_outreach_blocked: An email was stopped by the outreach rules

next.picksReady: {count, plural, one {Look at your first pick below.} other {Look at your # best picks below.}}
next.picksFinding: Your first picks are on their way; this page updates itself.
next.picksNone: Nothing fits exactly yet; new picks appear here as they open.
next.apply: Tap “Apply for me” on the ones you want. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
next.save: Save your scout with your email to keep it and apply.
next.keepGoing: We look again every day; anything that needs you shows up first.

save.title: Your scout is ready
save.body: It's saved in this browser for now. Save it to your email to keep it on any device and to apply. One code, no password.

planning.title: Planning where you head next
planning.body: We're reading your answers and files, choosing the path that fits you, and finding what's open now.

plan.failed: We couldn't plan that path. Try again.
plan.profileBody: The more we know, the sharper every pick.
plan.openNote: Live counts from the catalog, refreshed daily.
plan.deadlinesNone: None of your picks closes in the next eight weeks.
plan.moreDeadlines: {count, plural, one {# more closing soon} other {# more closing soon}}

none.title: Let Onward Scout plan your path
none.body: We read your answers and files, choose the path that fits you, and lay out the steps.
